BiblicalUsage: Ohel is one of the five sons of Zerubbabel named in 1 Chronicles 3:20, beside Hashubah, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed. He is not the tent of his near-namesake, but a man in the line of David after the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sons of Zerubbabel carry the line of David through the exile, and Ohel's name in the list keeps the promise alive.
